Initialize a dataset spine and cache it for the session

Source: R/api.R
sim_init.Rd

Builds the shared person/household/object spine (if not already cached) and prepares dataset-specific state so that subsequent read_sav() calls can assemble files without rebuilding.

Usage

sim_init(dataset = "woonbase", year = 2023L, n = NULL, seed = 42L)

Arguments

dataset

Dataset identifier (default "woonbase").

year

Simulation year (default 2023).

n

Number of persons to generate. NULL (the default) fetches the actual population count from bundled parameters for year. Note that n and seed only take effect when the shared spine is (re)built; if a spine for year is already cached, the existing spine (with its original n/seed) is reused. Call sim_reset() first to force a rebuild with a different n or seed.

seed

RNG seed for reproducibility (default 42).

Value

Invisibly NULL.

Details

The spine is shared across all datasets. Calling sim_init() for any dataset auto-builds the spine from woonbase parameters when needed.
